tex_content.html:
Proposition
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0074 1. Proposition 2.45\group neckpinch

If the diameter remains bounded as the singular time is approached, then the solution stays positive away from the equatorial hypersurface, so the singularity occurs only at the neck.
